precondition: Two enabled Email/Password test accounts; signed out.
action: Submit invalid credentials, then valid A credentials through the app.
expected: Readable auth error, then intended authenticated identity; no secret logging.
actual: Invalid login displayed an error; valid login authenticated intended test user A.

action: GET the exact Class B URL and validate each result.
expected: Exactly 5 decoded medium category-17 boolean questions.
actual: Exact URL returned 5 validated questions. Encoded: The%20Neanderthals%20were%20a%20direct%20ancestor%20of%20modern%20humans.; decoded: The Neanderthals were a direct ancestor of modern humans.

precondition: Isolated parser/HTTP regression tests; controlled HTTP responses and clock.
action: Inject malformed encoding, nonzero response_code, four results and invalid answer values; retry before/after 5 seconds.
expected: Invalid data cannot become playable; readable QuizException; no HTTP retry before 5 seconds.
actual: Local deterministic tests rejected malformed percent/UTF-8, nonzero API codes, four/six results, invalid answer values and metadata; five-second gate prevented early HTTP retries. No cloud behavior is simulated as evidence.

action: Use fixed True/False UI, correct/wrong choices and repeated selections.
expected: Continue disabled until selection; repeated answers blocked; text/icon/color feedback; 2/5 total.
actual: Actual UI: True precedes False, Continue locked until selection, text/icon/color feedback, choices disabled after answer; five review entries and repeated selection guard produced 2/5.

expected: New ID, zero score, empty selections, index zero.
actual: All 5 answers reviewed; replay allocated a new ID and reset every selection.

precondition: Completed round, online, no prior document at allocated ID.
action: Invoke Submit twice while transaction is pending.
expected: One immutable document, six fields, resolved timestamp, exact server-only confirmation.
actual: Double Submit produced one exact document with six fields, resolved timestamp and server-only confirmation.

precondition: Original T06 record exists; previous Android process force-stopped.
action: Start a fresh process, authenticate same A, retrieve original ID through app.
expected: Original 2/5 record returned from server without replay, question review or new write.
actual: Prior process force-stopped; fresh Android process signed in as same A and retrieved original 2/5 using actual app Source.server path, without quiz or write.

precondition: Completed round, networking disabled before transaction.
action: Submit offline, reconnect, wait for original operation, reconcile same ID and retry if absent.
expected: No false success or new ID; recover original round without overlapping retries.
actual: Network disabled before transaction; no false success. Reconnected, waited for original operation, reconciled original ID and recovered.

precondition: Online completed round; debug-only one-shot denied-read hook selected.
action: Real commit; inject first verification denial; manually retry same-ID server read.
expected: Acknowledged commit retained; labelled unavailable verification; final real read verifies same document.
actual: REAL transaction acknowledged; labelled injected permission-denied read; retry verified the same REAL server record (3/5). No second document.

precondition: Independent Firebase client authenticated as user B; A record exists.
action: Read A record and create under A path as B.
expected: Both rejected by deployed owner-only rules with permission-denied.
actual: Separate signed-in user B client was denied BOTH read and create under user A path by deployed rules.

precondition: User A authenticated; original valid record exists.
action: Development-only requests: score 6, extra field, update existing score; reread original.
expected: All invalid writes rejected; original score and timestamp unchanged.
actual: Deployed rules rejected score 6, an extra field, and update; original score and timestamp unchanged.

precondition: Online; debug-only unavailable or quota fault armed after real commit.
action: Inject each first verification failure and manually retry.
expected: Distinct visible error codes/messages; labelled injections; real final server read; no fake success.
actual: Labelled unavailable injection had distinct message and one manual server-read retry; real commit and final read. Labelled resourceExhausted injection had distinct message and one manual server-read retry; real commit and final read.

precondition: Two independent clients authenticated as A; one shared unused ID.
action: Concurrently submit scores 1 and 4 to same ID.
expected: Exactly one wins; other reports collision; final server payload matches winner.
actual: Two clients concurrently submitted 1 and 4 at same ID: collision:1, won:4; server winner 4/5.

precondition: Two independent clients authenticated as A; different unused IDs.
action: Concurrently submit scores 0 and 5 and read each original reference.
expected: Both succeed; each UID/ID/score stays associated with its initiating operation.
actual: Concurrent independent clients returned their own exact IDs and scores: …vE7eLy=0; …deH39i=5.

precondition: Actual A cloud response captured but delivery delayed.
action: Sign out A, sign in B, invalidate generation, then deliver old response.
expected: No A result/ID/acknowledgement is attached to B screen.
actual: Delayed delivery of actual user A server response after real sign-in as user B was discarded by generation/UID/ID guards.
